description_en: Modifies the name and entries of a specified port range list. You can add, modify, and delete entries
description_zh: 修改指定端口列表的名称、条目，支持增加、修改和删除条目
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-port-range-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --port-range-list-id prl-2ze97430000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyPortRangeList

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the port range list. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 端口列表所在地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the port range list to modify
parameters.help_zh: 待修改的端口列表 ID
parameters.name: port_range_list_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the port range list. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with http://, https://, com.aliyun, or com.alibabacloud. It can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 端口列表的名称。长度为 2~128 个字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://、https://、com.aliyun和com.alibabacloud开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: port_range_list_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the port range list. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 端口列表的描述信息。长度为 2~256 个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The description of the port range. The description must be 2 to 32 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://. Valid values of N: 0 to 200
fields.help_zh: 端口范围的描述信息。长度为 2~32 个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头。N 的取值范围：0~200
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The port range. Valid values of N: 0 to 200. Settings:

The number of entries cannot exceed the maximum entry capacity (`MaxEntries`).

You cannot specify duplicate values for `PortRange`.

The value cannot be the same as the value of the `RemoveEntry.N.PortRange` parameter
fields.help_zh:
端口范围，N 的取值范围：0~200。使用限制：

条目数量不能大于最大条目容量（`MaxEntries`）。

不允许设置重复的 `PortRange`。

不允许与`RemoveEntry.N.PortRange` 参数值重复
fields.name: port_range

parameters.help_en: The entries to add or modify in the port range list
parameters.help_zh: 增加或修改的端口列表条目数组
parameters.name: add_entry

fields.help_en:
The port range. Valid values of N: 0 to 200. Settings:

You cannot specify duplicate values for `PortRange`.

The value cannot be the same as the value of the `AddEntry.N.PortRange` parameter
fields.help_zh:
端口范围，N 的取值范围：0~200。使用限制：

不允许设置重复的`PortRange`。

不允许与`AddEntry.N.PortRange` 参数值重复
fields.name: port_range

parameters.help_en: The entries to delete from the port range list
parameters.help_zh: 删除的端口列表条目数组
parameters.name: remove_entry
